'''Nishr Base Seven''' was the headquarters of the [[Nishr Taskforce]] during the [[Nishr Campaign]]. It was located in an abandoned mine in the [[Lukhur Badlands]]. It had two levels. The top level was expanded to accommodate [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcrafts]] and to provide a command center for operations. The lower level was used for barracks.<ref name="ROE" />
